rules: H1 must be fluid, extremely large (e.g. text-[8vw] md:text-[10vw]) with leading-none and tracking-tighter.
Use ALL CAPS with wide tracking (tracking-widest) for overlines and labels.
Use text-balance for large headings to prevent awkward wrapping.

visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous. Use p-12, p-24, py-32 for sections.
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp (rounded-none) or very subtle (rounded-sm) for an architectural feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on borders and high contrast rather than soft shadows.
visual_enhancers.noise: Add a subtle grain overlay across the site to make it feel tactile.

layouts.hero: Kinetic Hero. Massive typographic statement with line-by-line reveal (framer-motion). An architectural image offset to one side or within a clipped frame. Subtle parallax on scroll.
layouts.manifesto: Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03) arranged in an asymmetric grid. Large numbers, clear typography.
layouts.gallery: Editorial image gallery. Images placed in strict grid cells, some cells empty. Use hover interactions (scale up image within hidden overflow container).
layouts.marquee: Slow, elegant scrolling text strip acting as a section divider.
layouts.contact: Split layout. Left: Clean, brutally simple form. Right: Company details (address, phone, email) in large, clear typography.

motion.reveal: Framer-motion for masking and revealing text line-by-line on load.
motion.parallax: Use Framer-motion useScroll and useTransform for subtle image parallax.
motion.hover: Images scale slightly on hover. Buttons have sharp background sweeps or inverted colors on hover.

components_to_use: Shadcn UI (Form, Input, Textarea, Button) - heavily customized for the brutalist/luxury theme.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST write ALL text in German.
You MUST install lenis, framer-motion, react-fast-marquee, and lucide-react.
Use a specific Google font like Cabinet Grotesk if available via CDN or replace with `font-sans` if importing another modern sans like Space Grotesk/Syncopate for headings.
Create a line-by-line text reveal animation for the hero section using framer-motion. Wrap lines in overflow-hidden spans.
For the image gallery, use clipped frames (e.g. wrapper with overflow-hidden and absolute image with scale animation on hover).
Build a contact form using HTML/Tailwind or Shadcn. Make it look brutalist/editorial (sharp corners, 1px borders, generous padding). Fields: Name, Email, Telefon, Service (Select), Datum, Nachricht.
The footer MUST contain the company information prominently: Amel's Team GmbH, Ravensburgerring 23, 81243 München, 089/87579385, Info@amel.de.
Do NOT use typical generic tech gradients. Stick to solid colors (Bone White, Deep Charcoal, Rust Orange).
Make the site responsive, ensuring the massive typography scales down properly on mobile (e.g. text-5xl on mobile, text-[10vw] on desktop).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (sharp corners or pill, depending on archetype). Here, use sharp.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
